upsert.note: Preface line: 'Add the following capability to dpipe.' States no requirement.
Command syntax line for the new quality command under the R8.S1 heading.
Description of the quality command. Paragraph-level because section R8.S1 also contains S8 and S9, which belong to other objects.
Parameters of quality (--input, --output). Parameters are not objects, so they belong to quality.
Behavior of quality: completeness, consistency, uniqueness.
Error cases of the quality command. The heading 'Error handling' is a section label, not a reference to the shared error handling object O20, so no edge.

interpretations_add.text: R8.S3.P3 chooses int or float only when all non-empty values parse as that type, so for int and float columns the fraction that parses is always 1.0. Read R8.S3.P5 as giving consistency 1.0 for int and float columns, and its mixed-type sentence as having no effect.
